notes.title: Geometric fractals in Beta update
notes.notes:
Hello!
A new thing has appeared in the beta branch - geometric 3D fractals. If you have the time and desire, I invite you to test them. Your opinion is important to me. Should I include them in the base version of the application?

notes.title: Fractal Gallery - Summer update!
notes.notes:
What's new:

 Now you can turn off the lights (switch at the entrance) and explore the gallery in the dark.
 New shader for water drops on glass during rain.
 Improved sound design.
 Moon!
 New content. Updated materials for some objects.
 New stereoscopic effects on hidden objects.
 Updated lighting and special effects on the secret level.
 Now, to exit the game, you can touch the handle on the door.
 Updated LOD for some assets. Better performance.
 Updated lighting for lightning flashes during rain. It became more beautiful.
 Fixed minor bugs.
 Reduced light bleed on side walls.
 High quality graphics and 2.5D fractals active by default.
 The dynamic fractal at the far wall is now always within the visible zone.
 Updated graphics engine. Improved performance and compatibility with new hardware. This stage will allow project to move to UE5 in the future.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
Gallery gets better with a new update!
What's new:

 10 new static fractals
 Adjusted the scale of fractals textures. Images of static fractals have become clearer and of better quality.
 Adjusted the quality of shadows and lighting.
 10 times faster loading.

notes.title: Update is here!
notes.notes:
What's new:

 Pressing the side button of the controller changes the distance from the floor. Useful for those who play while sitting.
 Now when you move the stick left and right, a 45-degree rotation is performed in the selected direction.
 For Oculus users: Game controllers are now disabled when invoking the menu.
 Fixed teleportation by pressing the button.
 Minor fixes in glass shader to speed up rendering.
 Reflections appeared in the windows.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Performance Emprovements
notes.notes:
Fixed teleportation algorithm for Oculus devices. There will no longer be a situation when the player teleports out of the level.
 Fixed rendering of blinking lights on buildings outside the window.
 Glass in windows now has reflections.
 Improved performance in non-HQ graphics mode.
 The graphic style of the teleportation beam has been improved.

notes.title: Autumn update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The Gallery update is here!

What's new:
- Improved performance. CPU usage reduced by 25%. More stable framerate.
- More interactivity in the Gallery.
- New Steam achievement added.
- It sometimes rains outside the Gallery.

I hope you enjoy the new update!
